checks.reason: Personalised five-year error must improve over the same-sample baseline; this alone would not establish clinical accuracy.
Ranking must at least exceed chance; exceeding 0.5 alone would not establish clinical accuracy.
The checking cycle was inspected during development; no independent final assessment exists.
No evidence establishes accuracy beyond observed follow-up or validates the remaining-lifetime extrapolation.
Survey self-reports have not been validated as equivalent to the clinical-record inputs.

nextEvidenceRequired: Suitable clinical/outcome data with permitted access and use.
An independent assessment against a predefined protocol, including lifetime assumptions.
Review of clinical input mappings and uncertainty before patient use.
scope: Completion of a feasibility assessment, not approval of a patient-prognosis model.
